message.title: FRO - Q3 2026 Presentation
message.body:
Please find enclosed the presentation of Frontline plc ́s third quarter 2026
results to be held on the webcast / conference call 20 November, 2026 at 15:00
CET.

This information is subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to section
5 - 12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.

category.category_en: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
